title: SEO Agency Amsterdam: Google and AI Answers | 22 Signals
description: An SEO agency for Amsterdam companies: Dutch and English search plans, technical fixes, content and GEO so you appear in Google and in AI answers.
h1: SEO and GEO for Amsterdam companies found in two languages and in AI answers
intro: 22 Signals is an SEO agency for Amsterdam companies that need to be found by Dutch and international buyers, in Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. We fix the technical basics, plan content for both languages, build authority and report on enquiries and sales, not vanity rankings.

p: Search behaviour in Amsterdam splits in a way that catches many companies out. Consumers and most Dutch businesses search in Dutch: "boekhouder Amsterdam", "fietsenmaker in de buurt", "zakelijke energie vergelijken". International staff, expats and European buyers often search in English for the same thing. A site that only covers one language leaves the other half of the market to competitors.

The two audiences also use different words for the same service and expect different proof. Dutch buyers look for reviews, clear prices and Dutch contact details. International buyers look for English case studies, credentials and evidence that you work across borders. A good SEO agency, Amsterdam or anywhere else, plans for both rather than translating one into the other.

sections.h: What Dutch results pages look like
p: For many commercial searches in the Netherlands, page one is crowded before your site even appears. Bol.com and other large marketplaces take product terms. Comparison sites and review platforms take service terms. Local results with a map take anything with a place name. For B2B topics, Dutch trade publications and government sites often hold the informational queries.

So a realistic plan picks its battles. Some keywords are worth fighting for directly. For others, the better route is a strong presence on the marketplaces and comparison sites that already rank, a well-kept Google Business Profile, or content that answers a more specific question than the big players bother with.

list: Technical SEO: crawling, indexing, speed, structured data, internal links and clean hreflang for nl-NL, nl-BE and English pages
Keyword research in Dutch and English, based on what buyers type, not what the team calls its services internally
Content plans and briefs for service pages, guides and comparison pages, written or localised by native writers through our partners
Local SEO: Google Business Profile, consistent company details across Dutch directories and review routines
Digital PR and links from relevant Dutch and European publications, built through useful content rather than bought links
Monthly reporting tied to leads, sales and revenue, with the next month's priorities in writing

sections.h: GEO: being the answer when buyers ask an AI
p: More buyers now start research by asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Google AI Overviews for a shortlist. Those systems draw on pages they can read and trust, and they favour sources that are clear, specific and consistent across the web. GEO, or generative engine optimisation, is the work of making your company one of those sources.

In practice it overlaps heavily with good SEO. We make sure your key pages state plainly what you do, for whom and where, with facts that can be quoted. We add structured data, build entity consistency across your site, LinkedIn, Dutch directories and press coverage, and publish content that answers the questions buyers ask assistants. Then we test the prompts your buyers are likely to use, in Dutch and English, and track whether and how your company is mentioned over time.

sections.h: Belgium, Germany and the rest of Europe
p: Many Amsterdam companies sell beyond the Netherlands. Flanders shares the language but not always the vocabulary, so a page written for Dutch searchers may not match what Belgian buyers type. Germany is a separate search market with its own competitors and its own expectations of detail. We set up international structures that let each market rank on its own terms, using country folders or domains depending on your setup, and we keep the technical signals clean so Google shows the right version to the right visitor.

sections.h: How we run SEO and GEO
p: Talk is a 15-minute call about your goals and the searches that should be bringing you business. Plan is a technical and content review of your site and competitors, ending in a written roadmap within 5 to 7 days that ranks fixes by expected impact. Build is the work itself: technical fixes, new pages, content and links, each scheduled with dates in writing. Grow is the monthly cycle of measuring results, checking AI answers and putting effort where it is working.

sections.h: Choosing an SEO agency: Amsterdam buyers should ask these questions
p: Before signing with anyone, ask for straight answers to the following. A good partner will welcome them.
list: Who writes the Dutch content, and are they native speakers?
How will you report results: rankings only, or enquiries and revenue?
How do you build links, and can we see examples?
What will you change on our site in the first month, and who approves it?
How do you check whether AI assistants mention us, and in which languages?
What happens to the content and reports if we stop working together?

p: We have worked with more than 30 companies across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe and the UAE. We will show you real search reports and the decisions behind them on a call, with client permission.

sections.h: How the work is reported, in English
p: Each month you get a written report covering rankings, traffic, enquiries and how often AI assistants mention your company, plus a list of the changes we made. Review calls are booked at times your team picks. Reports and strategy are in English. Dutch content is produced with native localisation partners or your own writers.

faqs.q: Should our site be in Dutch, English or both?
faqs.a: If you sell to Dutch customers, you need Dutch pages. If you also sell internationally or hire in English, add English. Most Amsterdam companies we speak to need both, set up with proper hreflang so each audience sees the right version.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SEO and GEO?
faqs.a: SEO helps you appear in search engine results. GEO helps you appear in answers from AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. The work overlaps, and we plan both together.

faqs.q: How long before SEO shows results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes can show effects within weeks. Content and authority usually take several months to build. Your roadmap sets out what to expect and when, with dates in writing.

faqs.q: Can you guarantee first place on Google?
faqs.a: No honest SEO agency can promise a ranking. We commit to the work, the dates and clear reporting on traffic, enquiries and sales.
Our team works in English. Dutch content is written or localised by native partners, or by your own writers using our briefs.

faqs.q: Can you help us rank in Belgium too?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up Belgian pages with their own hreflang tags and adjust the wording where Flemish searchers use different terms.
